profile_text.body:
Wix.com Ltd. is a public company headquartered in Tel Aviv and listed under the ticker WIX. Its own site describes a free website builder that offers more than 2,000 templates, built-in AI tools, and a custom domain, with the option to customize templates manually or with AI. The site also says users can sell products, services, and memberships from one dashboard without plugins, and that specialized AI agents are available to help keep a business growing.

The company's stated AI position rests on those built-in tools and specialized agents rather than on separately named AI products. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for Wix in the data reviewed.
